_comment: Hand-entered contract terms. The MLB Stats API carries no contract data at all,
and Baseball Reference salaries thin out for the most recent seasons, so this file
is the source of truth for anything you enter here — it overrides scraped salaries
and forces surplus_value to be recomputed.
Each entry matches either by "move_id" (copy it out of data/moves.json) or by
salary_paid is the total guaranteed dollars, not the average annual value.
Entries without a move_id or a player+date match (like this one) are ignored.
